QuestInfo.name: Evolving Ring Event
QuestInfo.0: The Evolving Ring Event is taking place to celebrate the arrival of spring! Go see Gaga to learn more about it.
QuestInfo.1: Stay logged in for an hour each day to evolve your ring! Talk to Gaga for details.
QuestInfo.2: Stay logged in for an hour each day to evolve your Evolving Ring. You can evolve it all the way up to Lv. 17, so keep at it and make the Ultimate Evolved Ring!

0.0: To celebrate the arrival of spring, I am handing out special Evolving Rings. Stop by and grab yours today!

yes.0: Stay logged in for an hour each day to evolve your ring and enhance its stats. You can evolve it all the way to Lv. 17, which means you'll have a very powerful ring by the end!

no.\"0: Stop by and see me if you want to grab a ring.

1.0: Are you here to collect your Evolving Ring?

yes.0: Talk to me again, and I'll explain the Evolving Ring in more detail and give you your very own ring so you can join in the fun!
